Codex and Claude Co"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"de have one. DSH didn't, so I built it. One pill holds the model picker and the slider, right where "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ne. DSH didn't, so I built it. One pill holds the model picker and the slider, right where you type."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"| Dark | Light |"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **One pill for model and effort.** Picker and slider share one bordered pill with a separator betw"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"een them. The slider sits right of the model name.
- **The model list skips the submenu.** One click"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" shows every provider and model. Effort stays on the slider and nowhere else.
- **Notches instead of"},{"id":"p7s4","text":" a smooth drag.** Each notch is a real effort level from the model, usually two to seven. Drag it, o"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"r focus it and use the arrows, Home, End. Screen readers get a real slider role.
- **A little show a"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"t the top notch.** Max effort turns the bar into a moving gradient, a nod to DSH's own "Deep diving."},{"id":"p7s7","text":".." shimmer. It stays still when you prefer reduced motion.
- **It follows your theme.** Every color"},{"id":"p7s8","text":" comes from DSH variables, with one accent shared with the send button. Light, dark, future theme pl"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"ugins, it all carries over.
- **It speaks your language.** Labels follow the DSH locale in English, "},{"id":"p7s10","text":"French and Chinese. Model and effort names stay exactly as the model sends them.
- **The context rin"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"g gets out of the way.** While the pill is up, the ring moves to the end of the stats row instead of"},{"id":"p7s12","text":" crowding the send button.
- **A taller prompt box.** About two lines, same as the DSH hero input.
-"},{"id":"p7s13","text":" **Nothing lives in core.** The plugin is one folder. Delete it and DSH forgets it was there."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"DSH with the `web` profile, and a model that exposes reasoning efforts. No effort levels, no slider."},{"id":"p9s2","text":" Anything with `low / medium / high` works."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Compatibility and permissions"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Needs the `web` profile (composer slots, model directory, locale). Pure client UI. No host permissio"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ns, no credentials, no network calls, no external services. Runs wherever the `web` profile runs. Te"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"sted on DSH `0.1.2-alpha`. Limitation: the pill only shows for models exposing reasoning efforts."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"From GitHub, no npm account needed:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Or clone it first:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Then restart the `web` profile once with `dsh web` and refresh the page. Pick a reasoning model in the pill.
2. Drag the slider and let go. It applies on release.
3. Push"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" it to the top notch for the gradient."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"If the model has no reasoning levels, the pill hides and the stock DSH selector is back."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Theming"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Everything runs off one accent, `var(--dsw-alias-button-info-fill)`, the send button fill.
